summary.text: Laura Pichardo is the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Jonah Garson (D).
She was born in Greensboro, North Carolina, and has worked as a global transaction services accounts payable analyst.

paragraphs.text: Laura Pichardo was born in Greensboro, North Carolina.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro in 2014 and a graduate degree from Winston Salem State University in 2018.
Her career experience includes working as a global transaction services accounts payable analyst.
Pichardo lost to Joseph Lee Haywood in the 2020 Republican primary for North Carolina's 6th Congressional District.
She was the Republican nominee for North Carolina State Senate District 23 in 2024, when incumbent Graig R. Meyer (D) defeated her 65.8% to 34.2%.
She advanced to the 2026 general election after the Republican primary was canceled.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Pichardo said she was passionate about education, the budget and protecting consumers, and said the state should invest in mental health programs for lower-income individuals to prevent crime.
